nodes.title: _CANON/index.md self-contradicts on Book II completeness
nodes.claim: _CANON/index.md's own Book II table lists 'Part IV: Sessions API' as status 'DRAFT (CONDITIONAL CLEAR pending),' while the same file's footer banner three lines below states 'Canonical Book II: Complete (Parts I-VI)' — a live, self-contained self-contradiction inside one document, not merely a stale claim contradicted by a separate source.
nodes.note: Confirmed by direct read of _CANON/index.md this pass: the Book II reference table's own Part IV row says DRAFT, and the file's closing banner line reads 'Canonical Book II: Complete (Parts I-VI)' with no caveat. This compounds the pre-existing book-ii-canon-parts finding: the missing Part IV is not just undocumented relative to the handoff history (no _CANON/book-ii/part-iv-*.md file exists on disk), the one file whose entire job is to track canon status contradicts itself about it in two adjacent sections.

nodes.title: AGENTS.md env-var table still lists RECOIL_PASSWORD as the live /recoil gate
nodes.claim: AGENTS.md's Environment Variables table still lists RECOIL_PASSWORD as 'Shared cookie gate for the whole /recoil* tree (src/proxy.ts, private-alpha)' — presented as the live gating mechanism for the internal /recoil surface.
nodes.provenance: AGENTS.md Environment Variables table (live, read directly)
nodes.note: Contradicted by the code it cites as its own source: src/proxy.ts line 68's comment reads '...fail-closed. The old shared RECOIL_PASSWORD cookie gate was a coarser...' (mechanism now retired), and src/lib/ammo-gate.ts line 6's comment reads '...by an ADMIN_EMAILS session. The old RECOIL_PASSWORD cookie was retired because...'. /recoil is now gated by an Auth.js session + ADMIN_EMAILS allowlist, not a shared password — meaning anyone who only had the old shared password (e.g. Amy at RecruitHaus, or any other external party from the private-alpha era) no longer has access at all. This is a real capability change the documentation was never updated to reflect.
